title: 5 of Your Favorite Makeup Artists on Their Favorite Lip Combos
summary: From breakout artist @paintedbyesther to the legendary Sam Fine, five makeup artists share their favorite lip looks of late, and how to achieve them.

title: Kayali Launches in China Exclusively With Sephora
summary: The Dubai-based fragrance brand has launched exclusively with the LVMH-owned beauty retailer, pairing a 300-plus-store rollout with a founder-led push.
author: Denni Hu

title: EXCLUSIVE: The Center and Dr. Mamina Turegano Acquire Boscia Skin Care Brand
summary: Ben Bennett’s The Center has partnered with board-certified dermatologist Dr. Mamina Turegano to acquire and relaunch Boscia, blending Asian skin care traditions with modern formulations.
author: Kathryn Hopkins
